intendedObjective: Reconstruct the orientation note as clear, friendly instructions.
acceptableEditScope: Substantially simplify and organize wording while retaining every actual step and responsibility; add no procedures.
stableFactsAndClaims: Retrieve an apron from the cupboard beneath the sink on arrival.
Payment handling and drink preparation are distinct; new volunteers do not handle payments on their first shift.
The shift leader pairs the newcomer with a drink preparer who shows order slips and the washing station.
Put the used apron in the laundry basket next to the cupboard and verbally notify the shift leader before leaving.
An unwell volunteer must immediately tell the leader and stop handling drinks.
protectedNamesNumbersDatesQuotesPhrases: laundry basket next to the cupboard
requiredForm: Clear instructions for a new coffee stall volunteer; organization may change.
